# M3-T11-121 — Phi evaluation/root difference: resultant support and denominator firewall


STATUS=PROVED_EXACT_STRUCTURE / WITHIN_SESSION_HOSTILE_AUDIT_PASS / NO_GLOBAL_POWER_SAVING
TYPE=GLOBAL_LINEAR_CUBIC_FACTOR_SUPPORT / NORMALIZATION_FIREWALL
POPULATION=Existing nondegenerate exact fixed-packet physical Stage37 endpoints with R<=B, restricted to the audited phi/1+3 image; one endpoint per count. No new population or height cutoff is introduced.
DEPENDENCIES=Audited 105 physical negative-square norm; 106 z_phys=S/2; 109/110 phi parameterization and root; 099/100 interior denominator depth; 120 correction. Audited 036 is used only for the already-known fixed-u counting comparison.
DUPLICATE_PREFLIGHT=Targeted current RESULT-LEDGER, active ROUTE, RESEARCH-INDEX, NEGATIVE-REGISTER and CARD-INDEX checks found the 120 correction's open difference/cubic correlation but no explicit homogeneous linear/cubic resultant or integer-difference support theorem below. This is not another fixed-u multiplicity theorem, local density factor, or replacement for 119.
ALIASES=PhiIntegerDifferenceTwistSupport; PhiLinearCubicResultant; PhiDifferenceDenominatorFirewall.


## 1. Exact integral factorization


Write primitive phi parameters r,s, and put
Q0=r^2+s^2,
Q1=r^2-4rs+5s^2,
N=r^2-2rs-s^2,
K=r^2+2rs-s^2,
U=-2s(r-s)N,
V=r^4-6r^3s+12r^2s^2-14rs^3+11s^4.
The physical branch has finite nonzero u=U/V. U^2+V^2=Q0*Q1^3; vartheta=N/Q0.


Define P(z)=V^2 Q_u(z). Exactly
P(z)=(Q0*z-N)*D(z),
where D(z)=d3*z^3+d2*z^2+d1*z+d0, with integer homogeneous coefficients
d3=Q1^3,
d2=N*(r^4+4r^3s-50r^2s^2+100rs^3-51s^4),
d1=4s(r-s)*(3r^4-17r^3s+35r^2s^2-41rs^3+32s^4),
d0=4s^2(r-s)^2*N.
The cubic D is not the conductor C_u. Its monic version is D/Q1^3.


The exact linear/cubic resultant is
Res_z(Q0*z-N,D(z))=2*Q1^2*N*K^3.
Equivalently,
Q0^3*D(N/Q0)=2*Q1^2*N*K^3.
For a nonzero rational parameter pair, Q0,Q1>0 and N,K are nonzero: their roots in r/s involve sqrt(2), and the infinity value is nonzero. Thus the factors never share a rational root here.


## 2. Integer evaluation support theorem


Let the actual evaluation point be z_phys=a/b=S/2 in lowest terms, b>0 and gcd(a,b)=1. These a,b are evaluation numerator/denominator, not the reduced numerator/denominator of u.
Set
L=Q0*a-N*b,
D_h=d3*a^3+d2*a^2*b+d1*a*b^2+d0*b^3.
The physical negative-square norm gives
L*D_h/(Q0*Q1^3*b^4)=-w^2,
so L*D_h=-Q0*Q1^3*(b^2*w)^2 with b^2*w rational.
Both factors are nonzero on the retained distinct-root physical locus. In particular L is not forced to vanish.


Let delta be the signed squarefree integer representative of L: L=delta*y^2 with y a positive integer. Then
rad(|delta|) divides rad(2*Q0*Q1*N*K).


Proof: take p not dividing 2Q0Q1NK. If p divides b, Q0*a is a unit modulo p, so p does not divide L. Otherwise a/b is defined modulo p. If both L and D_h vanished modulo p, N/Q0 would be a root of D modulo p, contradicting the nonzero resultant. Hence p|L implies p does not divide D_h. The displayed negative-square relation then forces v_p(L) even. This proves the support statement for all such primes, without a local-probability assumption. Bad primes are retained rather than divided away.


With H=max(|r|,|s|)>=1,
|delta|<=|2Q0Q1NK|<=640H^8.
For each fixed parameter pair there are at most 2^(omega(2Q0Q1NK)+1) signed delta labels; in the retained polynomial physical height range this is B^o(1). This is a support theorem, not a count of moving parameter pairs or a new endpoint saving.


## 3. Actual rational difference keeps the denominator


The true difference is
z_phys-vartheta=L/(Q0*b).
In Q^*/Q^{*2}, exactly
[z_phys-vartheta]=[delta*Q0*b].
Consequently the integer delta support theorem does NOT bound the rational linear etale component solely by 2Q0Q1NK. Odd-valuation primes of the moving evaluation denominator b can enter that component. They cannot be silently discarded or replaced by the phi parameter height.


For clarity, fixed (r,s) already fixes u and audited 036 already supplies B^o(1) physical endpoints. The B^o(1) number of delta labels at fixed (r,s) is therefore not a second saving. A fixed delta across varying (r,s) has no uniform B^o(1) endpoint theorem here.


## 4. Interior allocation consistency check


For a relative-fresh interior p^lambda, 0<c_p<2lambda, audited 099/100 and 106 give v_p(b)=k=2lambda-c_p, v_p(a)=0, and norm depth n=2lambda+c_p.
On Q0 allocation, v_p(Q0)=n>k and N is a unit, hence v_p(L)=k. Thus v_p(delta) mod 2=c_p mod 2. The rational difference has valuation k-n-k=-n, agreeing with the canonical negative-valuation root comparison.
On Q1 allocation, Q0,N are units and b is p-divisible, hence L is a unit. Thus p does not divide delta. But the rational difference has valuation -k, with parity c_p. The denominator restores exactly the local class that would be lost by using delta alone.
These checks recover the old local tuple; neither allocation supplies independent rarity. No statement is made here about endpoint occupancy at these primes, extreme-only support, or the withdrawn 120 valuation equalities.


## 5. Continuation and credit boundary


The valid global correlation problem now has explicit integral coordinates:
L=delta*y^2,
L*D_h=-Q0*Q1^3*(b^2*w)^2,
supp(delta) subset supp(2Q0Q1NK),
actual linear class=[delta Q0 b].
A useful next theorem must control moving (r,s), delta and evaluation denominator b jointly on the same physical R<=B measure, or produce a genuine cross-invariant constraint not implied by the existing norm and primewise tuple. In particular it must cover the full residual outside 119's height/conductor windows, including high-height shells. A mere sum over divisor-many delta values per fixed parameter adds no exponent credit.

## 1. Integral model and exact scalar correction


Put N=a^2+b^2, Delta0=2b^2-25a^2, T0=a^2+2b^2 and
F(X)=N X^4-8ab X^3+(11a^2-b^2)X^2+6ab X-a^2.
Then F=b^2 Q_u and its monic version F/N defines K_u on the S4 complement.


Let theta be its root and alpha=N theta. The integral monic polynomial of alpha is
G(X)=N^3 F(X/N)
=X^4-8abX^3+N(11a^2-b^2)X^2+6abN^2X-a^2N^3.


Exact discriminants:
disc(F)=16a^2 N^2 Delta0^3,
disc(G)=16a^2 N^8 Delta0^3.
Delta0!=0 for nonzero rational u, since 25(a/b)^2=2 has no rational solution.
The order Z[alpha] need not be maximal. Its index has no prime outside disc(G), which is all that the proof needs; do not equate order and field discriminants.


Write the actual physical z=S/2=m/n in lowest terms, n>0. Define
beta=N m-n alpha=N n(z-theta).
It is an algebraic integer and is nonzero since the physical norm is nonzero on the retained distinct-root locus.


For F_h(m,n)=N m^4-8abm^3n+(11a^2-b^2)m^2n^2+6abmn^3-a^2n^4,
Norm(beta)=N^3 F_h(m,n).
Audited105 gives F(z)/N=-w^2 for a nonzero rational w. Hence
Norm(beta)=-(N^2 n^2 w)^2.


The exact original squareclass is
[z-theta]=[N n beta] in K_u^*/K_u^{*2}.
This scalar correction is essential. beta is NOT generally the original class. The actual evaluation denominator has been removed from the normalized packet, not silently removed from the physical descent class.


## 2. Denominator-free finite-prime support theorem


Let S_u be the set of rational primes dividing 2aNDelta0, and S_K the prime ideals of O_K above S_u. Define
K(S_K,2)={ [c] in K^*/K^{*2}: v_P(c) is even for all P outside S_K }.


For every retained physical point,
[beta] belongs to K(S_K,2).


Proof: take p not in S_u. The order Z[alpha] is maximal and etale at p, N is a p-unit, and G mod p is squarefree.
If p divides n, primitiveness makes m a p-unit; beta=N m-n alpha is a unit at every prime above p.
If p does not divide n, beta can vanish only where alpha has residue N m/n in F_p. Squarefreeness means at most one prime ideal divides beta, and that prime has residue degree one. The p-valuation of Norm(beta) is therefore exactly its ideal valuation there. The norm is a negative rational square, so this valuation is even. All other valuations are zero.
This proves the statement, including primes in the moving evaluation denominator n. It is an ideal squareclass theorem, not an assertion that beta itself is an S-unit or a square.


At these odd good primes, the corresponding quadratic extension K(sqrt(beta))/K is unramified. Archimedean signs are retained; no positivity or full local Selmer condition is inferred.


## 3. Universal negative-square norm witness


Define the nonzero algebraic integer
gamma=alpha(aN-b alpha).


Exactly,
Norm(alpha)=-a^2 N^3,
Norm(aN-b alpha)=a^2 N^3 T0^2,
Norm(gamma)=-(a^2 N^3 T0)^2.


The second identity is the evaluation F(a/b)=a^2 T0^2/b^4. All quantities in the square are nonzero for a!=0, b>0.


Furthermore [gamma] belongs to K(S_K,2), with NO enlargement by primes of b or T0.
Proof: outside S_u, alpha is a unit by its norm. If p divides b, aN-b alpha is a unit everywhere. If p does not divide b, only the one degree-one prime with alpha=aN/b mod p can divide the second factor, and its norm valuation is even because Norm(aN-b alpha)=a^2N^3T0^2. The same good-order argument as Section2 applies.


Therefore the coarse supported norm fiber
H_u^-={c in K(S_K,2): [Norm(c)]=[-1]}
is NONEMPTY for every rational u on the retained S4 complement:
[gamma] belongs to H_u^-.


This is stronger than merely noting that physical points have norm [-1]. No physical point was used to construct gamma. Screening u by emptiness of this particular coarse supported norm fiber can never remove a u.


Important boundary: H_u^- is NOT the full genus-2 fake Selmer set, NOT the everywhere locally soluble descent image, and NOT the realized physical point image. gamma need not lift to any physical point or any full genus-2 two-cover. Smaller/local-compatible sets can still be empty. No Perfect Cuboid existence is inferred.


## 4. The remaining object is a norm-kernel coset


Let
V_u=ker(Norm: K(S_K,2) -> Q^*/Q^{*2}).
Then exactly H_u^-=[gamma] V_u.


For a physical point set
xi=beta/gamma.
It satisfies [xi] in V_u, and the original class is recovered as
[z-theta]=[N n gamma xi].


This preserves genuinely non-norm information instead of taking its norm and declaring it trivial. Neither xi nor V_u is proved trivial or fixed. The audited106/107 primewise tuple remains consumed; this construction gives no additional local selector at those primes.


## 5. Explicit finite-label bound and its missing counting adapter


There is the standard exact sequence
1 -> O_{K,S_K}^*/O_{K,S_K}^{*2}
  -> K(S_K,2)
  -> Cl(O_{K,S_K})[2]
  -> 1.
The map sends a class with even valuations outside S_K to the ideal square root class. Surjectivity follows because a 2-torsion ideal class has a square principal ideal in the localized ring.


Dirichlet gives |O_{K,S_K}^*/O_{K,S_K}^{*2}|=2^(r1+r2+|S_K|), and degree4 gives r1+r2<=4, |S_K|<=4|S_u|.
The localized class group is a quotient of Cl(K); for a finite abelian group, a quotient has no larger F2 dimension modulo2, so
|Cl(O_{K,S_K})[2]|<=|Cl(K)[2]|.
Consequently
|V_u|=|H_u^-| <= |K(S_K,2)|
<=2^(4+4 omega(|2aNDelta0|)) |Cl(K_u)[2]|.


No class groups were computed or assumed odd. No uniform B^o(1) bound for this moving quartic family is proved here.
For H=max(|a|,b), |2aNDelta0|<=100H^5 and |disc(K_u)|<=|disc(G)|<=64,000,000H^24. In a retained polynomial physical height range the elementary 2^omega factor is B^o(1); the class-group factor must remain.


Even an additional small-class-group theorem would only give few labels PER u. Audited036 already gives B^o(1) physical endpoints per fixed u. It would not reduce the number of moving realized u values, and labels in different K_u cannot be identified without an exact cross-field adapter. No bound on occupied u, no support-cardinality contraction and no fixed-power endpoint saving follows from this finite-label count.

## 1. Exact reduced cofactor adapter

## 2. Deterministic global label tail
Let U,V,L be integers >=1. Let T(U,V,L) contain reduced nonzero A/C with |A|<=U, C<=V for which SOME integer M>=L satisfies M^4|A. Allowing all M, all denominators and both signs only enlarges the physical support. Then
|T(U,V,L)| <= 2V sum_{M=L}^{floor(U^(1/4))} floor(U/M^4)
<= (8/3) VU/L^3.
Also |T|<=2UV; T is empty if L^4>U.
Proof: for each M there are floor(U/M^4) positive numerator choices and at most V denominators; signs cost2. Summing over M overcounts repeated labels, which is legal for an upper bound. The tail of sum M^-4 is at most L^-4+1/(3L^3)<=4/(3L^3). Coprimality and any restrictions on prime factors of M may be discarded for this upper bound.


Thus the EXACT physical subset with |A|<=U,C<=V,M_rel>=L satisfies
E_theta(B;U,V,L) <= B^o(1) min(2UV,(8/3)VU/L^3).
This is an endpoint bound via realized-label containment and ONE fixed-theta multiplicity, not an ambient divisibility probability. Uniformity uses the retained polynomial-height interface; no assertion is made for arbitrary external theta of superpolynomial height.


Dyadically L<=M<2L, the same bound follows by counting pairs (M,q), |q|<=U/L^4, then denominators. Neither q nor theta is independent from the old carrier.


## 3. Feasibility and target
For a nonempty shell, U>=L^4 is necessary. In power notation U=B^u,V=B^v,L=B^m (constant factors allowed),
E_theta <= B^(u+v-3m+o(1)),
and a sufficient scoped one-twelfth window is u+v-3m<1/12, with a fixed strict margin.
Feasibility requires u>=4m and v>=0, so this exponent is at least m. Therefore this particular bound cannot itself supply a fixed saving below B^(1/12) on shells with m>=1/12. If a hard threshold is instead B^(1/12-eta), keep eta explicitly: feasibility alone does not rule out the intervening window. No global theorem forcing U,V into the sufficient window has been proved.


This is a limitation of the displayed receiver, not a lower bound for physical endpoints.


## 4. Sharp coarse-constraint obstruction
In the RELAXED label space choose M=p, theta=p^4/1 for primes L<=p<=2L with p=5 mod12, omitting primes from any fixed finite exceptional packet.
These distinct labels satisfy nonzero theta, fresh split-prime support p=1 mod4, denominator coprime to M, fourth-power divisibility, and the p=5 mod12 exact saturation v_p(A)=4v_p(M).
With U=(2L)^4,V=1 the count is asymptotic to L/(4 log L) by the fixed-modulus prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions. Hence these explicitly listed coarse constraints alone cannot imply O(L^(1-delta)) for any fixed delta>0. Taking L=B^(1/12) gives B^(1/12-o(1)) relaxed labels.


IMPORTANT SCOPE: These are not asserted to arise from any physical endpoint, reduced (a,b,s,t), rational r, elliptic point with v=u², or exact R<=B. https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/18-785-number-theory-i-fall-2021/mit18_785f21_pset9.pdf

## 1. Exact physical equations and notation

Writing F=N0*Psi and g=gcd(|F|,Hden), theta=A/C is reduced with
A=M^4*F/g, C=Hden/g.
The full fraction gcd gcd(|NQ|,Hden) equals g because gcd(M,Hden)=1. Thus the new theorem controls the actual cancellation retained by124.


## 2. Odd denominator parity theorem
THEOREM: For every reduced theta=A/C!=0 on the necessary physical square locus above, every odd prime p not dividing b has v_p(C) even.


Proof. It suffices to show gcd(|NQ|,Hden) has even valuation at those p, since Hden is a square. Let h=v_p(a),k=v_p(s); p is odd and b is a unit.
(a) If h=k=0, p does not divide Hden.
(b) If h>0,k=0, N and Q are units; the gcd valuation is0.
(c) If h=0,k>0, t is a unit and Q=4a²t² modp is a unit. If p does not divide N the gcd valuation is0. If p divides N, Phi=-16a²t^4 modp is a unit, so Omega²=-N Phi forces v_p(N) even. The gcd valuation min(v_p(N),2k) is even.
(d) If h,k>0, N and t are units. If h!=k, the first and last terms of Q have distinct valuations2k and2h, while the middle term has valuation at leasth+k. Consequently v_p(Q)=2min(h,k), giving even gcd valuation.
If h=k=e, v_p(Q)>=2e and v_p(s²J)>=4e. If v_p(Q)<4e, Phi=-4t²Q+s²J has that same valuation; Omega² with N a unit forces v_p(Q) even. If v_p(Q)>=4e, the gcd is capped at v_p(Hden)=4e. Both cases give even gcd valuation. No division by3 or11 was used; those odd primes are included. theta=0 is excluded.


## 3. The only possible odd-parity primes and their residue conditions
If an odd prime p has v_p(C) odd, then p|b by Section2. Thus p does not divide a or N.
If p|s then Q=4a²t² modp is a unit and v_p(C)=2v_p(b*s), which is even; hence s is a unit.
Odd v_p(C) then requires
0<v_p(Q)<2v_p(b), v_p(Q) odd,
v_p(C)=2v_p(b)-v_p(Q).
Modulo p, Q=a²(s²+4t²), so s²+4t²=0. Since s is a unit, t is a unit too. Hence -1 is a square modulo p and p=1 mod4.


Under b=0 and s²=-4t² modulo p,
Phi=a²(s^4+44s²t²-16t^4)=-176a²t^4.
Therefore -N Phi=16*11*a^4*t^4 modulo p. Since p=1 mod4 excludes p=11, this is a nonzero unit. The necessary physical square equation forces 11 to be a quadratic residue modulo p.


COROLLARY: There is a UNIQUE decomposition
C=2^epsilon*d*k², epsilon in{0,1}, k>=1,
where d is odd squarefree, d|b, and every p|d has p=1 mod4 and (11|p)=+1.
No statement fixing epsilon is made. d need not be1. The complete necessary square equation remains stronger than this denominator consequence.


A local caution: (a,b,s,t)=(1,5,1,1) gives theta=-39/5, and -N Phi=-2964 is a unit square in Q_5 (its residue is1 mod5). Thus an odd b-prime may have odd denominator valuation compatibly with the local square equation. This tuple fails the real square condition and is NOT a physical endpoint. It only blocks strengthening the LOCAL argument to all denominators being squares; no global nonsquare-denominator endpoint is asserted.


## 4. Actual b-height denominator occupancy
Restrict the original exact R<=B, fixed content/coefficient packet, generic full-S theta!=0 population further by b<=H, |A|<=U,C<=V,M_rel>=L, where U,V,H,L>=1 are integers and physical-induced heights remain polynomial in B.
Let D(V,H) be the number of positive denominators admitted by Section3 for SOME b<=H. Since d|b, d<=H. Dropping squarefreeness, oddness and the residue restrictions for an upper bound gives
D(V,H) <= sum_{1<=d<=H} (floor(sqrt(V/d))+floor(sqrt(V/(2d))))
<= 2(1+1/sqrt2)*sqrt(VH) <4sqrt(VH).
Also D(V,H)<=V. A denominator might be counted several times in this enlarged sum; this is safe. There is NO sum of endpoint multiplicities over b: denominators are first unioned and each theta is counted once.


For a single fixed b, the analogous bound is
D_b(V) <= (1+1/sqrt2)*sqrt(V)*sum_{d|b,d odd squarefree} d^(-1/2)
<=2*tau(b)*sqrt(V).
This fixed-b estimate is an auxiliary denominator statement, not an extra fixed-u endpoint saving.


Replacing124's denominator factor V by the UNION count above yields
E_theta(B;U,V,H,L)
<= B^o(1)*(8/3)*(U/L³)*min(V,4sqrt(VH)).
This is a same-exact-R<=B endpoint bound for the stated subset, using audited093 fixed-theta multiplicity exactly ONCE. It is not a density product. If U<L^4 the subset is empty. Restrictions on admissible M or coprimality can only shrink the set.


In power notation U=B^u,V=B^v,H=B^h,L=B^m,
E_theta <= B^[u+min(v,(v+h)/2)-3m+o(1)].
The denominator improvement is a factor sqrt(V/H) when H is smaller than V at fixed-power scale. No theorem imposing such a scale on the WHOLE physical population is promoted.


## 5. Feasibility and hard-branch boundary
A sufficient scoped one-twelfth window is
u+min(v,(v+h)/2)-3m <1/12-delta
with a fixed strict margin.
Nonemptiness still requires u>=4m and v,h>=0. Hence the displayed exponent is at leastm.
On the actual hard threshold M_rel>B^(1/12-eta), the receiver alone cannot guarantee the required B^(1/12-delta) with delta>eta: its sufficient power exponent cannot fall below the conductor scale. This is a limitation of this receiver, NOT a lower bound for actual endpoints.


124's relaxed labels theta=p^4,C=1,M=p=5mod12 also satisfy the new coarse denominator consequence (epsilon=0,d=1,k=1), for any H>=1. They are still NOT physical homogeneous realizations. Thus adding just this denominator consequence to the coarse fourth-power/saturation constraints does not remove124's barrier. This does not rule out using the FULL Omega²=-N Phi equation, v=u², rational-r, actual cancellation/cofactor relation or other physical constraints to obtain a sparse realized numerator image.

## 1. Scope of the negative result
127 tests adding a GLOBAL rational point realizing126's component vector, instead of only independent local cosets. There are polynomial-height relaxed families with such a single global point, actual theta cofactor formula, v=u²,125's square denominator consequence, and original rational-r square compatibility at2,3,infinity and every fresh prime.
There is no proved contraction of the FULL physical realized (M,q,C) support. Global r, other places, actual coefficient/content packet and exact physical height remain essential. Non-torsion, positive Mordell-Weil rank, full Selmer nonemptiness or cuboid existence is NOT asserted.


## 2. Gaussian and CRT construction
Let M>=17 have every prime divisor p=17mod24. Choose one Gaussian prime orientation above each p and let alpha_G be their product with the exponents of M, so Norm(alpha_G)=M. It is primitive: no rational prime divides it because at each split p only one conjugate orientation occurs. Write
alpha_G²=a+i b
after choosing signs and a Gaussian unit so a,b>0. Then
a²+b²=M², gcd(a,b)=1, a odd, 8|b, gcd(ab,M)=1, 1<=a,b<M.
For the parity: each p=1mod8 has a representation r²+t² with r odd and4|t; their oriented products retain odd real coordinate and imaginary coordinate divisible by4, so its square has imaginary part divisible by8. No axis coordinate can vanish in a primitive nontrivial oriented product. Moreover a²=M²-b²>=2M-1, hence a>=6.


Choose t0 satisfying
t0=1 modb,
t0=(8a)^(-1) modM,
1<=t0<=28M².
If 3|b no further3-adic choice is needed.
If 3|a (the only other possibility since a²+b²=M² and3 does not divide M), also choose t0 so F(t0)=9mod27, with F defined in Section5.
This exists: modulo3, F(T)=T²-1, with a simple root atT=1. Hensel lifting F(T)-9 gives a root mod27. Since3 does not divide bM, the27 possible choices t0=1+b(k0+jM),0<=j<27, traverse all residues mod27 while preserving the first two congruences. Here k0 is the least nonnegative solution of1+bk0=(8a)^(-1) modM. This also proves the height bound and gcd(t0,bM)=1.


Set
u=a/b, s=b, t=M²t0, S=s/t, N0=1.
Both u and S are reduced. At every p^lambda||M,
v_p(a²+b²)=v_p(t)=2lambda, a,b,s,t0 units.
These are the full-S normalization equations, NOT a claim that a physical conductor/packet has been realized.


## 3. Actual cofactor and square denominator
Define
Psi=b²-12ab²t0+4a²M²t0²,
q=Psi/4=a²M²t0²-3ab²t0+b²/4.
Because8|b and a,M,t0 are odd, q is odd.
Modulo a, q=b²/4 is a unit; modulo b, q=a²M²t0² is a unit. Thus
g=gcd(Psi,(2ab²)²)=4.
Consequently the actual124 reduced fraction is
theta=A/C, A=M^4*q, C=(ab²)²,
gcd(A,C)=1.
From the fresh CRT equation8a*t0=1modM,
Psi=-b²/2modM, q=-b²/8modM, so gcd(q,M)=1.
Hence every fresh valuation of theta is exactly4lambda, not merely a fourth-power lower bound.125's denominator consequence holds with epsilon=0,d=1.


q>0: the negative term divided by a²M²t0² is at most3/a<=1/2, and b²/4 is nonnegative.
Useful polynomial bounds:
q<=785M^8, A<=785M^12, C<=M^6, t<=28M^4.
These are auxiliary arithmetic heights, NOT physical R.


## 4. A SINGLE global rational point realizes all components
Put v=u²,w=u/S=aM²t0/b² and

The exact094 identity gives theta=(v+1)((v+1)-12w+4w²)/(4v).
Direct substitution therefore proves
Z²=X(X²+(9+4theta)X+4theta).
Thus P belongs to E_theta(Q), without a rational-r assumption.


At all fresh p, w has valuation2lambda;126 applies with e=v_p(q)=0. The curve has split I_(8lambda), and the SINGLE global P has
kappa_p(P)=+/-2lambda mod8lambda,
component order4 simultaneously at all p|M.
This is a true diagonal global image, not independently selected p-adic points. Still it is not a physical point or a global4-torsion assertion.


Also x_Legendre=N0*s/(16ab*t0)=1/(16a*t0)=1/2modM.
With ell=(theta-3(v+1))/16,
r²_required=ell+x_Legendre(1-x_Legendre)=1/4modp
at every fresh p. It is a unit square in Q_p by Hensel lifting. These local roots do not supply a common rational r.


## 5. The exact MISSING global square condition
For this family define the integral quartic
F(T)=a²M^6*T^4-3ab²M^4*T³-((11a²-b²)M²b²/4)*T²+ab^4*T-b^4/16.
The divisions by4 and16 are integral since8|b.
Substituting the retained endpoint Phi with s=b,t=M²t0 gives
-Phi/M²=16F(t0),
and exactly
r²_required=F(t0)/(4ab²t0)².
Therefore original rational r exists for this family IFF the positive integer F(t0) is an integer square. This is not implied by its global E_theta point.


The stated partial local compatibility is rigorous:
- 2: F(t0)=1mod8, since its leading term is an odd square and all remaining terms are divisible by8.
- 3: if3|b then F(t0)=1mod3; if3|a the CRT choice gives F(t0)=9mod27, valuation2 with square unit.
- fresh p: Section4 gives r²_required=1/4modp.
- real: F(t0)>0. Relative to a²M^6*t0^4, the negative cubic term is at most1/2, the negative quadratic term at most11/(4M²), and the constant at most1/(16a²M²); their sum is less than1 forM>=17. The positive linear term may be ignored.
No claim is made about r at other finite primes, or about its global square. Even a global r here would not by itself establish all physical splitting/packet/height conditions.


## 6. Polynomial-height abundant CURVES, not physical endpoints
Take M=p prime=17mod24 in [L,2L]. Fixed-modulus PNT AP gives (1+o(1))*L/(8logL) primes.
Each resulting reduced A is at most785*(2L)^12 and divisible byp^4 exactly. If a single theta arose from4 distinct such primes, its same reduced numerator would be at leastL^16. ForL>=50 this contradicts the upper bound. Thus each theta has at most3 such prime witnesses, and there are at least(1/24+o(1))*L/logL distinct theta values.


The j-function is
j(theta)=16(16theta²+60theta+81)^3/[theta²(16theta²+56theta+81)].
For a fixed finite j, the equation has degree6 with nonzero leading coefficient. Each j has at most6 rational theta preimages. Hence at least(1/144+o(1))*L/logL distinct j-values, and at least that many distinct Q-isomorphism classes of smooth curves, carry the global point/component and stated coarse adapters.


This lower bound is ONLY for the constructed relaxed curve family in polynomial parameter-height boxes. It is NOT a bound under physical R<=B, not a physical numerator count, and not a full theta-route impossibility theorem. It blocks obtaining O(L^(1-delta)) from the listed relaxed conditions ALONE. Stronger actual height restrictions, remaining local conditions or the original global r equation can remove these impostors.

# M3-T11-128 — Exact real evaluation image versus the universal norm witness

TYPE=GENUINE_NON_NORM_LOCAL_COMPATIBILITY / NORMALIZATION_AND_SCALAR_QUOTIENT_FIREWALL
POPULATION=Audited123 irreducible-S4 rational-u complement of retained nondegenerate fixed-packet physical endpoints, one endpoint one count.

## 1. Exact coordinates and the curve being tested
Use123's N=a²+b², D0=2b²-25a²,
F(X)=N X⁴-8abX³+(11a²-b²)X²+6abX-a²,
theta_root=theta, alpha=Ntheta,
G(X)=N³F(X/N), beta=Nm-nalpha, gamma=alpha(aN-balpha), xi=beta/gamma.
The ACTUAL physical z=S/2=m/n is reduced with n>0. Restore
[z-theta]=[Nn beta]=[Nn gamma xi].
Nn is positive at infinity. Thus beta and the original evaluation have identical real signs; beta cannot be confused with the original class at finite places.


The necessary residual curve is C_u: w²=-F(z)/N, with w!=0. This squarefree quartic defines a genus1 curve after smooth completion, not the full genus2 physical cover. Physical points project to it by105. We compute only its non-root affine real evaluation image and the induced necessary physical condition; we neither identify its fake Selmer set with the full physical cover nor prove a lifting converse.


## 2. Exact root ordering, without numerical precision assumptions
disc(F)=16a²N²D0³, F(0)=-a²<0, F(a/b)=a²(a²+2b²)²/b⁴>0. D0 cannot vanish for nonzero rational u.
F has at least two real roots since its leading coefficient is positive and F(0)<0. A separable real quartic with positive discriminant has zero or four real roots, and one with negative discriminant has two. Consequently:
D0>0: four real embeddings; D0<0: two real embeddings and one complex pair.


For a>0, Descartes applied to F(-X) gives exactly one negative root: its coefficient signs are +,+,(either sign),-,-, with one variation. In the four-real case the other three roots are positive. Write r1<r2<r3<r4. Since F(0)<0 and F(u)>0, either r2<u<r3 or r4<u. The second possibility contradicts Vieta:
sum r_i=8u/(1+u²)>3u, whereas r1<0 and the other three roots<u would give sum r_i<3u. Here D0>0 implies u²<2/25, so the strict inequality holds. Hence
a>0,D0>0: r1<0<r2<u<r3<r4.
a>0,D0<0: r1<0<r2<u.
For a<0 use F_{-a,b}(X)=F_{a,b}(-X) and reflect the ordered roots:
a<0,D0>0: r1<r2<u<r3<0<r4.
a<0,D0<0: u<r1<0<r2.
The roots of G are N*r_i, so their order agrees. Neither 0 nor u is a root.


## 3. The real evaluation image and gamma's mismatch
In increasing root order, beta_i=Nn(z-r_i). For real non-root points on C_u, F(z)<0. Thus its exact sign image is
four real roots: E_inf={+---, +++-}, from z in(r1,r2) or(r3,r4);
two real roots: E_inf={+-}, from z in(r1,r2).
Every displayed vector is realized on the residual REAL curve; omitted physical packet/pole constraints can make the actual physical image smaller. These are not rational-point existence assertions.


gamma_i=N²*r_i*(a-b*r_i). It is positive precisely for roots strictly between0 andu. Therefore:


| Regime | sign(gamma) | necessary sign(xi) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| D0>0,a>0 | -+-- | {--++, -+-+} |
| D0>0,a<0 | --+- | {--++, -+-+} |
| D0<0,a>0 | -+ | {--} |
| D0<0,a<0 | +- | {++} |


In the four-real regime, BOTH gamma and -gamma miss E_inf. Thus123's universal supported norm[-1] class fails even the residual real evaluation condition, including after quotienting by rational scalars. In particular xi cannot be the identity squareclass for a physical point there. This is a genuine distinction beyond the norm condition: gamma is still a valid member of the coarse norm fiber, with Norm(gamma)=-(a²N³(a²+2b²))².


In the two-real regime, gamma fails the normalized image for a>0 but -gamma passes its REAL sign test. For a<0 gamma itself passes. Hence gamma is NOT excluded in the rational-scalar quotient in this regime. Never extend the four-real exclusion to all u or confuse failure of a representative with failure of its projective descent class. Passing this real test establishes no finite local/global compatibility.


## 4. Exact finite-packet signature adapter, retaining class groups
Let V_u be123's supported norm kernel and sigma_inf:V_u -> E_r the sign homomorphism, where E_r consists of vectors with product+1 in the r real embeddings. Complex norms are positive. Put W_u=ker(sigma_inf), and let T_u be the xi set in the table. Define ONLY the necessary real-compatible normalized packet
H_u^{-,inf}={gamma*xi:xi in V_u, sigma_inf(xi) in T_u}.
Then exactly
|H_u^{-,inf}|=|T_u intersect sigma_inf(V_u)|*|W_u|.
In particular it is at most2|W_u| for four real roots and at most|W_u| for two real roots. The set can be empty; no signature surjectivity or nonemptiness is assumed. The universal gamma construction does NOT prove this smaller packet is nonempty in the four-real regime.


For four real embeddings the ambient norm[-1] real sign set has8 vectors and E_inf has2; after quotienting by simultaneous sign reversal there are4 ambient classes and2 evaluation classes. These ambient ratios are NOT probabilities on the global packet or physical measure. sigma_inf(V_u) may be a proper subgroup; its intersection with T_u must be calculated, not replaced by a1/4 factor.
Retain123's bound
|V_u|<=2^(4+4omega(|2aND0|))*|Cl(K_u)[2]|.

# M3-T11-130 — Actual cubic unit root excludes strict-interior fresh allocation


Date: 2026-09-30. Current authority: Stage37 Drive, batch129 controls. Status: PROVED_EXACT_PHYSICAL_INTERIOR_EXCLUSION / WITHIN_SESSION_ADVERSARIAL_AUDIT_PASS / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT0. This is an internal rederivation, not an external review.


## Primary result and dependencies


On the canonical finite-u, nondegenerate physical packet branch, every odd split fresh prime p^lambda || m_i has only extreme allocations c_p=0 or c_p=2lambda. No physical packet has 0<c_p<2lambda. This concerns original physical anti-roots, not quartic algebra roots.

## Exact proof


Suppose 0<c_p<2lambda, hence 0<k<2lambda and n>k. The terms involving S dominate E and P, so v_p(E)=v_p(P)=-(n+k)=-4lambda. Set g(X)=p^(n+k)f(X), an integral p-adic polynomial. Its ascending coefficient valuations are (0,0,n,n+k). Mod p it is a nonzero unit multiple of X-u, because P/E reduces to u. Thus it has exactly one unit root V in Q_p, reducing to u; its derivative there is a unit. Any physical unit anti-root must equal this V.


Direct substitution gives


f(u)=u^2 [u(A-4)/A-S].


Since p is odd and v_p(A)=n>k, A-4 is a unit, and the bracket has valuation -n. Therefore v_p(g(u))=k. Since u and V have the same residue, the factorization g(u)-g(V)=(u-V) times a p-adic unit proves v_p(V-u)=k exactly. Also V+u is a unit, since p is odd. Consequently


v_p(V^2+1)=v_p(A+(V-u)(V+u))=k<2lambda.


This contradicts the original physical condition v_p(v_i^2+1)>=2lambda. The strict-interior branch is empty. The argument needs no N_u square hypothesis, S4 hypothesis, rational discriminant square assumption, residual Selmer computation, or independence model.


## Independent contradiction check


If the physical unit root V existed, V mod p=u and both V^2+1 and u^2+1 would vanish to depth at least 2lambda. The same simple Hensel branch of X^2+1 would force v_p(V-u)>=2lambda, whereas the actual cubic forces the exact smaller depth k. This uses the actual anti-root V only. It does not identify quartic theta with physical z=S/2 and does not revive retracted120.

# M3-T11-131 — Extreme actual anti-root orientation and coupled linear congruence


Authority: Stage37 Drive current130, MAIN/INDEX/ROUTE/RESULT-LEDGER and130 card freshly read. Status: PROVED_EXACT_EXTREME_LOCAL_CLASSIFICATION / WITHIN_SESSION_ADVERSARIAL_AUDIT_PASS / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT0. Audit is internal, not independent external review. TI remains parked.


## Result


For an odd split relative-fresh p^lambda || m_i on the nondegenerate physical branch, put L=2lambda, A=1+u^2, u=a/b reduced, S=s/t reduced with t>0. Retain130: strict interior allocation is empty. The two remaining cases have the following actual targeted anti-root V:


| Allocation | Exact valuations | Actual unit root-line |
| --- | --- | --- |
| c_p=0, denominator extreme | v_p(A)=L, v_p(S)=-L | V congruent u mod p^L; V^2+1 divisible by p^L automatically |
| c_p=L, Gaussian extreme | v_p(A)=2L, S and S-u units | V^2+1 divisible by p^L iff 2S congruent u mod p^L; then V congruent -u mod p^L |


The Gaussian case additionally has both pole roots in Q_p iff chi_p(-2/A_0)=+1, with A_0=A/p^(2L) a unit. Under the displayed root-line congruence this character is sufficient for all three cubic roots over Q_p with valuations (0,-L,-L); there is no additional higher-precision cubic-splitting obstruction. This only classifies the actual cubic plus its targeted root-line, not the entire Gaussian-core/physical lift.


In particular, if N_u=a^2+b^2 is a rational integer square, A is a rational square and A_0 is a local square. A Gaussian-extreme fresh prime must then satisfy p=1 mod8. Fresh primes p=5 mod8 must be denominator extreme. This is not a fixed-power density or a global endpoint theorem.


## Exact proof: denominator extreme


ROUTE35 gives f(X)=X^3-SX^2+EX-P, E=4u(S-u)/A, P=4u^2S/A. Its roots are the actual physical v_i; ROUTE36–37 give one targeted unit root with norm depth >=L and two pole roots of valuation -L. At c_p=0, g=p^(2L)f is integral with ascending coefficient valuations (0,0,L,2L). Its reduction is a nonzero multiple of X-u; there is a unique unit root V, with unit derivative. The identity


f(u)=u^2[u(A-4)/A-S]


has valuation at least -L, because both bracket terms have valuation -L. Consequently v_p(g(u))>=L and, by the unit-derivative factorization, v_p(V-u)>=L. Since v_p(A)=L, the norm V^2+1=A+(V-u)(V+u) has valuation >=L. This required root-line imposes no extra condition on S in this branch. Pole-root splitting is still a separate condition; no denominator-extreme support count is proved.


For a simple pole reduction, writing s_0=p^L S and a_0=A/p^L, the scaled cubic p^(3L)f(Y/p^L) reduces to


Y [Y^2-s_0Y+4u s_0/a_0].


Its quadratic discriminant s_0^2-16u s_0/a_0 must be a square modulo p. A nonzero square is sufficient by Hensel; the zero-discriminant case is not disposed of here. This is the existing045 Legendre receiver in pole-root coordinates, not a newly chargeable density.


## Exact proof: Gaussian extreme


Here v_p(A)=2L and v_p(S)>=0 from allocation. The actual roots give v_p(E)=v_p(P)=-2L: the product of the two pole roots uniquely dominates E and all three root valuations determine P. Since P=4u^2S/A, S is a unit, and E=4u(S-u)/A forces S-u a unit. The exact norm saturation is already retained042, not a new theorem; independently, if the capped branch had v_p(A)>2L, the P valuation would force v_p(S)>0, and E would then have the wrong valuation.


Now g=p^(2L)f has unit constant and linear coefficients; its remaining coefficients vanish modulo p. Its unique unit root reduces to uS/(S-u). Because u^2=-1 mod p, the norm of this residue vanishes iff 2S=u mod p. In that case its residue is -u, not +u.


Direct evaluation gives


f(-u)=u^2 [u(4-A)-S(A+8)]/A.


For a root V reducing to -u, the same unit-derivative factorization gives


v_p(V+u)=v_p(g(-u))=v_p(u(4-A)-S(A+8)).


As v_p(A)=2L, this valuation is >=L iff 2S-u vanishes modulo p^L (p is odd, so8 is a unit). Since V-u is a unit, V^2+1=A+(V+u)(V-u) vanishes modulo p^L iff V+u does. This proves the exact equivalence, including the case where the bracket is zero. When the congruence fails already modulo p, the norm root-line fails already modulo p.


Under 2S=u mod p^L, the pole-scaled cubic reduces to


Y [Y^2+2/A_0].


Thus two pole roots require chi_p(-2/A_0)=+1. Conversely this gives two simple nonzero roots and one simple zero root modulo p, hence all lift uniquely; the nonzero roots give poles of valuation -L, and the zero root corresponds to the already-certified unit V. For square N_u, chi_p(A_0)=1 and p=1 mod4, so chi_p(-2/A_0)=chi_p(2); the elementary supplementary law gives p=1 mod8. This character also restates the discriminant-square equation: Q(S,u)=2 mod p under u^2=-1 and S=u/2. It is not an independent second saving.


## Global integer receiver and nonzero firewall


Let M_D be the product p^lambda over denominator-extreme fresh primes and M_G over Gaussian-extreme primes. Then M_D M_G=M_rel, the factors are coprime, Q_S=M_D^2, C_u=M_G^2, and the exact fresh norm is M_D^2 M_G^4. These are retained130/042 routing identities.


The new Gaussian root-line equivalence gives the integral coupled receiver


H_G=2 b s-a t,
M_G^2 divides H_G,
gcd(a b t,M_G)=1.


This links the same physical S and u; it does not identify distinct anti-roots. The targeted anti-root has orientation +u at D primes and -u at G primes. No product of three root-line densities is taken.


Moreover H_G cannot vanish on a physical packet: H_G=0 implies S=u/2, whereas the original split-discriminant quartic satisfies exactly


Q(u/2,u)=u^2(112+145u^2+u^4)/16>0 for real u!=0.


This contradicts Y^2=-(1+u^2)Q(S,u). Hence |H_G|>=M_G^2. It is a legitimate nonzero integer divisor lock on the original packet, not yet a height/counting theorem. Do not replace physical R<=B by arbitrary heights of a,b,s,t, or assume uniform residues of H_G.


If N_u=c^2 and e=v_p(c)>0 at a fresh prime: denominator allocation requires lambda=e; Gaussian allocation requires e even, lambda=e/2 and p=1 mod8. This is an exact assignment restriction, not an endpoint population estimate.

# M3-T11-133 — physical half-angle lift forces square norm; exact signed reconstruction and Gaussian extreme routing

## Authority, conventions and scope
Current authority: MAIN/INDEX/RESULT-LEDGER/active ROUTE and latest132. Targeted source reads: ROUTE17 common physical phase, ROUTE24 full double-lift equation, ROUTE29 distinguished roots, corrected ROUTE32 distinct anti-roots, ROUTE35 symmetric cubic, residual105/106 (ROUTE118/120), and retained131/132. No full historical reread. Work on finite nonzero u and nondegenerate physical endpoints; u=infinity and singular/content branches remain separately retained. Use the actual signed anti-root definitions z_i=i v_i, not independently chosen signs of their squared traces. Quartic theta is never identified with a physical direction or anti-root.


Write normalized physical directions a_i=x_i+i y_i=Q/r_i in Q(i), N(a_i)=1, x_i=e_i/R>0, and sum x_i²=1. The y_i are signed complementary face diagonals divided by R. ROUTE24 gives
 C=a_2 a_3, s=a_1/a_2, t=a_1/a_3.
Here C,s,t are torus coordinates; below S=sum v_i and u is the corrected symmetric parameter. These notations must not be conflated.


## 1. Exact anti-root-to-physical-direction adapter
The G3-targeted root from29 is z_3=1+(1+C²+C²s²)t/(Cs). Substitution gives
 z_3=1+a_1²+a_2²+a_3^(-2).
Similarly, using the s-target quadratic and the corrected G1 relabeling (Cs,t/s,1/s),
 z_2=1+a_1²+a_2^(-2)+a_3²,
 z_1=1+a_1^(-2)+a_2²+a_3².
The real parts vanish because sum x_i²=1. Thus exactly,
 v_i=2(sum_j x_j y_j)-4x_i y_i,
 S=2 sum_j x_j y_j,
 d_i:=(S-v_i)/2=2x_i y_i.
Consequently every physical point satisfies the SIX simultaneous rational-square conditions
 L_i^+²=1+d_i, L_i^-²=1-d_i,
where L_i^+=x_i+y_i, L_i^-=x_i-y_i. None can vanish: a rational unit-circle point cannot have x_i=+/-y_i, since 2x_i²=1 has no rational solution.


This is a global physical lift beyond merely having a rational split cubic, residual quartic point, or local root-lines. It is the original physical condition expressed in actual anti-root coordinates, not a new independent acceptance probability.


## 2. NEW global consequence: N_u=a²+b² is necessarily a square
The symmetric cubic is f(X)=X³-SX²+EX-P, E=4u(S-u)/(1+u²), P=4u²S/(1+u²). Let A=1+u². Exact evaluation gives
 product_i(1+d_i)=f(S+2)/8=(2+S+Su)²/(4A),
 product_i(1-d_i)=-f(S-2)/8=(2-S+Su)²/(4A).
Both products are rational squares on a physical point. At least one numerator is nonzero: if both vanish, subtracting yields S=0 and then 2=0. In fact neither vanishes on a rational physical lift by Section1. Therefore A is a rational square.


If u=a/b is reduced, b>0, then A=(a²+b²)/b². An integer that is a rational square is an integer square, so
 N_u=a²+b²=c², c>0, gcd(a,b)=1.
This is a necessary theorem on the finite physical branch, not an assumption or a sufficient criterion. It restricts moving u to a rational Pythagorean conic, for example u=2r/(1-r²) with rational projective r and appropriate sign chart. It is NOT a thin-set/counting theorem on exact R<=B. No B^(-epsilon) factor follows merely from ambient conic sparsity.


Rational cubic splitting does not imply this norm-square condition: u=-1/2,S=4/5, roots (-4/5,-2/5,2) satisfy all displayed cubic identities, but N_u=5 is nonsquare, and cannot lift physically. This example is an algebraic enlargement, not a physical point.


## 3. Gaussian extreme: p==5 mod8 forced onto D, unconditionally on physical points
Retain131: at a fresh Gaussian extreme p^lambda||m_i, L=2lambda, v_p(A)=2L, S and S-u are units, 2S=u modp^L and the targeted unit anti-root V=-u modp^L. Put rho=u modp, rho²=-1. Then
 d_i=(S-V)/2=3rho/4 modp,
 1+/-d_i=1+/-3rho/4 modp.
The exact residue identities are
 (3+/-rho)²=8(1+/-3rho/4).
For p!=5 the two factors are nonzero and each has quadratic character (2|p). For p=5 one factor is zero, but the other equals2 and is a nonsquare. Hence every odd split fresh G prime must satisfy
 p==1 mod8.
All fresh p==5 mod8 therefore belong to the denominator extreme D, without separately ASSUMING N_u square.


This also follows from the newly proved global N_u square and131's retained pole splitting criterion chi(-2/A0)=1: A0=A/p^(4lambda) is now a p-adic square, so chi(2)=1. These are TWO PROOFS OF ONE restriction, not two independent filters. On p==1 mod8, the targeted half-angle square factors are nonzero square units, and their deeper square lifting is automatic by Hensel. Do not charge another local precision gain. Other half-angle components, signed compatibility and global packet reconstruction remain live.


N_u square means all surviving physical u lie in the square-norm branch already explored in129. The129 certified S4 family and residual all-place separate local persistence remain valid within their nonphysical scope. They do not automatically satisfy these six squares or give actual physical endpoints. The general123 scalar/class-group framework remains retained; physical norm-square restriction narrows its base parameters rather than computing Cl(K_u)[2].


## 4. Exact finite signed reconstruction and physical height
For a fixed ordered rational anti-root triple v_i, put d_i=(S-v_i)/2. Choose rational L_i^+,L_i^- with the six square equations above. A compatible normalized cuboid direction lift is EXACTLY a sign choice satisfying
 sum_i L_i^+ L_i^-=-1,
 x_i=(L_i^++L_i^-)/2>0,
 y_i=(L_i^+-L_i^-)/2.
Proof: x_i²+y_i²=1, 2x_i y_i=d_i, and
 sum x_i²=(3+sum L_i^+ L_i^-)/2=1.
Conversely every actual lift supplies these L_i. Moreover sum d_i=S, so reconstructing the signed anti-roots from x_i y_i recovers precisely v_i, not merely v_i². With a_i=x_i+i y_i and C,s,t above,
 F(C,s,t)/(Cst)=4(sum x_i²-1)=0,
and the distinguished root formulas recover z_i=i v_i.


There are at most2^6=64 sign choices, fewer after positivity/canonical ordering; no moving rational parameter is concealed in this direction lift. This does not replace the retained fixed-u subpolynomial theorem or prove a moving-support deficit.


For each retained positive sign branch define
 R_0=lcm_i Den(x_i), e_i=R_0 x_i.
Then e_i are integers, sum e_i²=R_0². Also R_0 y_i is an integer: its square is the integer R_0²-e_i² and a rational square root of an integer is integral. The quadruple is primitive since any common divisor of R_0,e_i would contradict minimality of R_0. In fact gcd(e_1,e_2,e_3)=1 as well, since a common prime divisor of all e_i divides R_0 by the sphere equation.
Thus the exact primitive Euclidean space-diagonal height is R=R_0. Apply R_0<=B directly, not height(u) or height(S). Rational face diagonals are R_0 y_i up to sign. To enter the fixed Stage37 T11 packet, still verify original content, Gaussian orientation, parity, cyclic-cover and coefficient kappa conventions. The sign system alone is not a blanket converse for a preassigned packet. Count each reconstructed canonical endpoint once.


For integral audit coordinates v_i=A_i/B_i, S=s/t reduced with B_i,t>0, the six rational square conditions are equivalently the six integer-square tests
 J_i^+/-=2t B_i[2t B_i +/- (s B_i-t A_i)].
No coprimality of these unreduced factors is assumed; q=n/d is a rational square iff nd is an integer square when d>0. Their shared denominators and the two global product identities prohibit independent density multiplication.

## 1. Exact reduced denominators recover R and the entire content triple
In the primitive reduced space triangle write x_i=C_i/D_i, y_i=F_i/D_i, with C_i²+F_i²=D_i², D_i odd and gcd(C_iF_i,D_i)=1. Hence
 d_i=2C_iF_i/D_i²,
 Den(d_i)=D_i² EXACTLY, with no cancellation.
Also Den(1+d_i)=Den(1-d_i)=D_i², and the reduced denominators of L_i^+=x_i+y_i and L_i^-=x_i-y_i are both D_i. No fresh or content coefficient is silently discarded.


Therefore, given a lifted anti-root triple, set q_i=sqrt(Den((S-v_i)/2)). Then q_i=D_i and
 R=lcm(q_1,q_2,q_3),
 h_i=R/q_i,
 tau=gcd(q_1,q_2,q_3)=q_1q_2q_3/R²,
 c_i=q_i/tau,
 R=(h_1h_2h_3)tau.
All these are exact integers. The lcm formula follows also from133's R=lcm Den(x_i), since each Den(x_i)=D_i. The recovered h_i are pairwise coprime by ROUTE6; the equivalent product/gcd formulas are not extra independent constraints.


Thus the physical height is intrinsic to the ordered anti-root triple, independent of a lift sign search:
 sqrt(lcm_i Den(d_i))<=B.
In a fixed content packet this is exactly (h_1h_2h_3)tau<=B with q_i=tau*c_i. Moreover Den(S) and each Den(v_i) divide R², since S=sum d_i and v_i=S-2d_i. These are exact physical denominators, not an ambient rational box or an assumed B-uniform packet constant.


## 2. NEW physical router: all odd split fresh relative primes are denominator extreme

The corrected ROUTE37 gives the targeted actual anti-root v_i a p-adic unit (v_p(v_i)=0), while the two other anti-roots have poles of depth2lambda. Since
 S-v_i=2d_i,

No cancellation against a unit can alter this pole depth.


Insert the retained040/48 conservation law

## 3. The signed compatibility equation is automatic on the symmetric surface
Define the symmetric surface polynomial
 T(v)=(SE+P)²-S²P(4S-P), E=sum_{i<j}v_iv_j, P=v_1v_2v_3.
For delta_i²=1-d_i² there is the exact eliminant identity
 product_{epsilon_i in {+1,-1}}(1+epsilon_1 delta_1+epsilon_2 delta_2+epsilon_3 delta_3)=T(v).
An explicit radical-free left side, with q_i=1-d_i², is
 [1+sum q_i²-2sum q_i-2sum_{i<j}q_iq_j]²-64q_1q_2q_3.


If all six1+/-d_i are rational squares, choose rational square roots L_i^+,L_i^- and delta_i=L_i^+L_i^-. Since T(v)=0, some sign choice has sum delta_i=-1. Flipping one root sign realizes each delta sign. Thus133's signed sum is NOT a further independent arithmetic filter once the six squares and the symmetric surface are imposed.


On the nondegenerate open branch d_i!=0 and1+/-d_i!=0, the compatible delta-sign triple is UNIQUE. If two triples worked, the sum over the nonempty set of flipped deltas would be zero. A singleton would force delta_i=0 and d_i²=1, impossible because the six rational squares would include2. Flipping all three contradicts sum delta_i=-1. For fixed compatible deltas, simultaneous flipping of L_i^+,L_i^- only changes the signs of x_i,y_i; x_i>0 selects exactly one choice per direction. Therefore an ordered signed anti-root triple has a UNIQUE positive normalized direction lift, improving133's safe at-most64 bound.

STAGE37 CONTINUATION RESULT — M3-T11-135
# M3-T11-135 — square-norm descent makes the x=-1/8 physical carrier empty


STATUS=PROVED_EXACT_SINGULAR_CARRIER_EMPTINESS / WITHIN_SESSION_ADVERSARIAL_AUDIT_PASS / GENERIC_MOVING_SUPPORT_OPEN
AUDIT_MODE=WITHIN_SESSION_REDERIVATION_NOT_INDEPENDENT_EXTERNAL
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0

## Authority and scope


Continue from MAIN/INDEX/RESULT-LEDGER/active ROUTE current134. Targeted reread:133/134 and ROUTE52–53 (045/046), later singular-shell89–99 and generic100. Known history was not reread in full. T11 remains primary; TI remains parked. All conclusions concern the actual signed anti-roots and finite rational symmetric u, not quartic theta or arbitrary residual local points.


New conclusion: the finite-u nondegenerate physical carrier x=-1/8 has NO endpoints, for every content/coefficient packet and every R. This strengthens its old audited fixed-packet one-twelfth retirement. It does not prove a new generic power saving, primary closure, P/M3 limit or perfect cuboid nonexistence.


## 1. The old carrier and the newly available physical restriction


Use S=sum v_i, A=1+u², u=a/b reduced with b>0, and the Legendre coordinate x=A S/(16u). On x=-1/8,045/046 give


 S=-2u/A,
 f_u(z)=z³-Sz²+Ez-P=(Az-2u)(Az²+4uz-4u²)/A².


The quadratic factor has discriminant 16u²(u²+2). Since u is finite, rational and nonzero, rational anti-root splitting requires a rational w with w²=u²+2. Equivalently the old primitive conic was W²=a²+2b². This conic alone has infinitely many rational points and its old Gaussian lattice receiver did not prove emptiness.


133 now supplies the separate necessary physical identity A=k² with k rational and positive, equivalently a²+b²=c² with c an integer. For completeness it follows from d_i=(S-v_i)/2=2x_i y_i and the six nonzero physical squares 1±d_i: their products are (2+S+Su)²/(4A) and (2-S+Su)²/(4A). At least one numerator is nonzero, so A is a rational square.134 allows four square tests plus A square on the symmetric open mask; neither rational splitting nor the singular conic by itself licenses this restriction.


## 2. Exact descent obstruction, independent of fresh prime allocations


Suppose both necessary conics hold. Choose w>0, k>0. Then w>|u| and


 L=w+u>0, M=w-u>0, H=2k>0,
 L²+M²=2(w²+u²)=4(1+u²)=H²,
 LM/2=(w²-u²)/2=1.


Thus they produce a rational right triangle of area1. Such a triangle is impossible by the following elementary infinite descent, included so that the new adapter does not depend on an unproved elliptic-rank calculation.


Clear denominators and divide by the gcd of the integer legs. The primitive integer right triangle still has square area: scaling multiplies area by a rational square, and an integer that is a rational square is an integer square. Select a hypothetical primitive square-area triangle of minimal integer hypotenuse. Its legs are 2mn,m²-n² and hypotenuse m²+n² with m>n>0, gcd(m,n)=1 and opposite parity. Its area is mn(m+n)(m-n). These four positive factors are pairwise coprime, hence each is a square:


 m=e², n=f², m+n=g², m-n=h².


The latter two are odd squares. Set r=(g+h)/2, s=(g-h)/2, both positive integers. Then


 r²+s²=(g²+h²)/2=m=e²,
 rs/2=(g²-h²)/8=n/4=(f/2)².


Because g,h are odd, g²-h² is divisible by8, so n is divisible by4 and f is even. Therefore (r,s,e) is another integer right triangle with square area. Its hypotenuse e=√m is strictly smaller than m²+n². If it is not primitive, dividing its gcd preserves an integer square area and only decreases its hypotenuse further. This contradicts minimality.


Consequently there is no rational u with both 1+u² and u²+2 rational squares. In particular


 PHYSICAL_FINITE_U_X_MINUS_ONE_EIGHTH_OCCUPANCY=EMPTY.


This is exact set exclusion, not a sieve probability. No denominator-density factor, Gaussian determinant or independence assumption is used. It applies also to packets with empty relative-fresh support and at content-supported or2-primary primes, because its argument is global over Q and does not use primewise allocation. It does not state a new theorem for the projective u=infinity chart or for other x values.


The physical square-norm restriction also makes the old residual kernel D=sf(N_u/M_rel²) equal1 wherever the integral quotient is defined. That identity alone would not exclude the carrier; the descent above supplies the missing global obstruction.


## 3. Relation to old results and remaining research


045/046 singular conic, Gaussian factorization and local root destination statements remain correct in their original necessary-condition scopes. The080–089 fixed-packet bounds and later audited retirement remain valid, but their x=-1/8 physical support receivers are now vacuous on this finite-u physical locus. Do not resume its moving-D, dual-conductor sigma or two-fresh-core Gaussian pair as a live physical count. The conic, cubic-split and local enlargement examples remain legitimate nonphysical examples; the new emptiness does not classify arbitrary conic points as endpoints.


The x=27/40 shell is NOT eliminated by this proof. Keep its existing audited retirement and stated scope. Generic x support remains open. Fresh denominator-only134 routing remains c_p=0, Q_S=M_rel², C_u=1 and M_G=1 on the original odd split fresh support;130/131/132,129 residual persistence and123 class groups retain their stated scopes.120 physical adapter remains RETRACTED. No identification of quartic theta with v_i is reinstated.


The surviving generic physical count must still use four square tests 1±d_1,1±d_2, A square, the symmetric surface, exact q_i=√Den(d_i)=tau*c_i and R=lcm q_i=(h_1h_2h_3)tau<=B, plus original orientation, coefficient and cyclic masks.134's unique positive direction lift provides one endpoint per canonical state. Fixed-u, fixed-x or fixed-tau multiplicity alone does not count moving support. No ambient rational-height count substitutes for exact R.


## 4. Verification and adversarial audit


The proof is infinite descent, not bounded enumeration. The attached exact Python replay separately samples the old singular conic and square-norm conic; verifies coefficientwise cubic factorization, the area and triangle identities, coprimality used in descent, and the descent algebra. Wolfram symbolic replay returned {0,0,1}: zero factorization error, zero triangle equation error and area1. Physical endpoints enumerated0. Finite searches cannot establish nonexistence; they only check adapters.


Within-session adversarial audit PASS: denominator clearing preserves square area; primitive Pythagorean parametrization is legitimate; factor coprimality includes the2-primary parity case; f is even so the new area is integral; the new hypotenuse strictly decreases; all new exclusion claims are restricted to the finite-u x=-1/8 physical carrier. This is not an independent external audit.

## 1. New full-conductor-square necessary condition


Let p^lambda||m_i be an odd split fresh relative prime outside all content/coefficient support. Put L=2lambda and q=p^L.134 forces c_p=0, so S has pole depth L and A has zero depth L. Write s0=qS and a0=A/q, both p-adic units. The targeted anti-root V=v_i is a p-adic unit; the other roots v_j,v_k have pole depth L. Put Y_j=q v_j and Y_k=q v_k, both units. All congruences below are in Z_p modulo q.


Multiplying the actual cubic f(z)=z³-Sz²+Ez-P by q² gives, at its unit root V,


 0=q²V³-q s0 V²+4u(s0-qu)V/a0-4u²s0/a0.


Reduction modulo q leaves 4u s0(V-u)/a0=0, whose prefactor is a unit. Thus V==u mod q. This is the retained131 D unit-root congruence, rederived to avoid importing any extra density factor.


The sum/product identities now give


 Y_j+Y_k==s0 mod q,
 Y_jY_k=q²P/V==4u s0/a0 mod q.


Define Delta_l=q d_l. Since S=V+v_j+v_k,


 Delta_i==(Y_j+Y_k)/2==s0/2,
 Delta_j==Y_k/2, Delta_k==Y_j/2 mod q.


All three Delta_l are units by the original equal-tau hypotenuses. For each l choose the actual rational square root L_l^+ with (L_l^+)²=1+d_l. Its p-adic valuation is -lambda, hence alpha_l=p^lambda L_l^+ is a unit and


 alpha_l²=q(1+d_l)==Delta_l mod q.


In particular choose alpha=alpha_j, beta=alpha_k. Then


 alpha²+beta²==s0/2 mod q,
 alpha² beta²==u s0/a0 mod q.


All displayed divisors are units. Consequently the SAME endpoint satisfies


 x=a0 s0/(16u)
   ==s0²/(16 alpha² beta²)
   ==(s0/(4alpha beta))² mod q,


 x-1==((alpha²-beta²)/(2alpha beta))² mod q.


Therefore, at every original fresh prime, BOTH x and x-1 are squares modulo p^(2lambda), with x a unit square. CRT gives


 x==X² mod M_rel², x-1==Z² mod M_rel²,
 gcd(X,M_rel)=1.


Here x is p-integral at every fresh prime; rational residue reduction uses its denominator inverse. Z need not be a unit. These are necessary residue-square constraints, not the global claims x in Q² or x-1 in Q². No precision beyond the stated p^(2lambda) is asserted, especially on collision x==1 mod p.


Since p==1 mod4, -1 is a square modulo these odd prime powers. The simultaneous condition implies the old045 Legendre square x(1-x), but the converse fails: modulo13, x=6 gives x(1-x)=9 while x=6 is nonsquare. Thus this adds information from the ORIGINAL physical half-angle cover, not merely another expression for the old product character.


## 2. Exactly how much local information is added


For a split prime p and nonsingular residue x notin{0,1}, the number with BOTH x and x-1 nonzero squares is (p-5)/4, versus (p-3)/2 with old x(1-x) nonzero square. Elementary proof: x=a², x-1=b², a,b nonzero gives (a-b)(a+b)=1. Parameter t=a-b lies in F_p^*. Exclude t²=1 (b=0) and t²=-1 (a=0), four values in total. Of p-1 parameters p-5 remain, with four (a,b) sign witnesses per x. This proves the count without an independent-character assumption.


Each such noncollision x lifts to p^(L-1) classes modulo p^L having both x and x-1 unit squares by simple odd-prime square-root lifting. Hence for p>=13 the strengthened receiver still retains a positive constant fraction of all residues, asymptotically1/4. At p=5 the noncollision count is0. If5 is fresh, physical x must therefore satisfy x==1 mod5. This is a finite-prime collision router, not a global power saving. Within 0<v_p(x-1)<2lambda the square congruence forces even valuation; at or above2lambda only the truncated statement is claimed. The alpha²+beta² square condition and norm-square a0 can impose still more local restrictions on lifted witnesses. No converse is claimed that every residue pair with x,x-1 square has a full physical lift. ## 1. Complete the pending leading square-witness compatibility

# M3-T11-138 — Primitive physical half-angle projective height and degree-eight inverse


STATUS=PROVED_PHYSICAL_PROJECTIVE_HEIGHT_AND_UNIFORM_EIGHT_FIBER
AUDIT=WITHIN_SESSION_ADVERSARIAL_REDERIVATION_PASS_NOT_EXTERNAL
GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0
PRIMARY_GATE=M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN
TI=PARKED
NEXT=M3-T11-139 PrimitiveHalfAngleProjectiveDegreeEightExactRSupport


## Authority and scope
Continue MAIN/INDEX/RESULT-LEDGER/active ROUTE current137, latest137 card, and targeted133/134 inverse/height and older Fricke discussion. No full-history reread. T11 remains primary; TI remains parked. Work on actual primitive integer positive cuboid edges e_i, space diagonal R, signed opposite-face diagonals f_i, e_i^2+f_i^2=R^2, sum e_i^2=R^2, gcd(e_1,e_2,e_3)=1. Preserve canonical orientation, original content/coefficient/cyclic/parity packet masks, exact physical R, one endpoint one count. The at-most-eight inverse uses134 finite nonzero-u nondegenerate open mask. No quartic-theta/physical-antiroot identification;120 physical adapter remains retracted.


## 1. Primitive global plus vector, with no projection content loss
Put x_i=e_i/R, y_i=f_i/R, d_i=2x_i y_i, S=sum d_i, v_i=S-2d_i. Define A_i=e_i+f_i and w_i=x_i+y_i=A_i/R, so w_i^2=1+d_i.


R is odd: if R were even, sum e_i^2=0 mod4 forces all three edges even. Each e_i,f_i has opposite parity, hence A_i is odd. Also A_i is nonzero: e_i=-f_i would give R^2=2e_i^2, impossible for nonzero integers.


The integer triple A is primitive. If an odd prime p divided all A_i, then f_i=-e_i modp, so 2e_i^2=R^2 for each i. Summing gives 2R^2=3R^2 modp, forcing p|R and then p|all e_i, a contradiction. The prime2 cannot divide A. Consequently gcd(A_1,A_2,A_3)=1: the projective representative has no moving common divisor. In addition gcd(A_i,R)=h_i=gcd(e_i,R): after dividing by h_i, the primitive circle pair C_i,F_i and hypotenuse D_i=R/h_i satisfy gcd(C_i+F_i,D_i)=1. For an odd prime divisor of D_i and C_i+F_i the same circle calculation forces both C_i,F_i divisible; D_i is odd.


## 2. Uniform physical-height equivalence
The standard projective height H_+=H([A_1:A_2:A_3]) is exactly max|A_i|. The upper bound is H_+<=sqrt(2)R. Since sum x_i^2=1 and sum y_i^2=2, Cauchy gives
sum (A_i/R)^2=3+2 sum x_i y_i >=3-2sqrt(2).
Thus
((sqrt(2)-1)/sqrt(3))R <= H_+ <= sqrt(2)R,
and in particular R/5 <= H_+ <= sqrt(2)R.
These constants are independent of content packets. This is a proved pushforward of the physical R measure; it is not an arbitrary ambient-height replacement.


## 3. Actual global ratios couple all three leading receivers
Define t_1=A_2/A_3, t_2=A_3/A_1, t_3=A_1/A_2. They are nonzero rational numbers with t_1 t_2 t_3=1 and each reduced rational height at most H_+. Put z_i=t_i+t_i^-1 and g_i=z_i^2/4. Direct expansion gives
z_1^2+z_2^2+z_3^2-z_1 z_2 z_3=4,
(g_1+g_2+g_3-1)^2=4g_1 g_2 g_3.
Each g_i and g_i-1 is a rational square, and g_i>=1 over the real numbers.


At a137 fresh p^lambda||m_i the corresponding leading receiver is g_i modulo p^(2lambda), with the appropriate physical ratio or its reciprocal and its inherited unit/square masks. These are three actual global ratios with product1, not the single CRT residue T of137 made into a global rational parameter. No independent character probabilities may be multiplied.


Novelty firewall: bare Fricke identities already occur in ROUTE26–31 for Gaussian norm-one phases. The new claim here is the physical integer plus-vector, its primitive projective height uniformly comparable to R, and the finite physical inverse below. Old phase sign/rootline assertions do not transfer automatically.


## 4. A degree-at-most-eight inverse, never an identically zero scale polynomial
Fix a projective point with all A_i nonzero and write r=(A_1/A_3,A_2/A_3,1). The remaining physical scale K=w_3^2=(A_3/R)^2 is a positive rational square. Define
d_i(K)=K r_i^2-1, S(K)=sum d_i(K), v_i(K)=S(K)-2d_i(K),
q_i(K)=1-d_i(K)^2=K(2r_i^2-Kr_i^4).
Then define
H_r(K)=[1+sum q_i^2-2sum q_i-2sum_(i<j)q_i q_j]^2-64q_1 q_2 q_3.
This is the134 signed-sphere eliminant T(v(K)). It has degree at most8 and H_r(0)=1 for every r. Therefore no specialization of r makes the scale equation identically zero, even when the leading degree drops.


To see necessity directly, set delta_i=x_i^2-y_i^2. Then delta_i^2=q_i and sum delta_i=-1. Eliminating the signed square roots from this relation gives precisely the displayed H_r(K). Equivalently it is (SE+P)^2-S^2 P(4S-P), where E=sum_(i<j)v_i v_j and P=product v_i.


Every physical preimage has H_r(K)=0. There are at most8 rational K values. On the134 nondegenerate open mask each K determines d and v, and the positive normalized physical direction is unique by134; its primitive integer endpoint is unique. Hence each projective plus point has at most8 canonical physical endpoint preimages in this scope. This is a uniform bound, not a claim of degree exactly8 at every point.


The converse requires K>0 a rational square, all 2-Kr_i^2 rational nonzero squares, compatible signed sphere lift and positive x, actual plus-vector signs matching the fixed projective point up to one simultaneous global sign, and all original packet and exact-R masks. Roots alone are not physical endpoints. Independent sign flips change the projective point. Zero-edge test samples below do not enlarge the theorem's endpoint scope.


## 5. Same-measure support receiver, no counting credit
Let E_pkt(B) be the canonically witnessed physical endpoint population in the stated open packet with R<=B. Let A_+(B) be the cardinality of projective plus points realized by exactly that population. Then
A_+(B) <= E_pkt(B) <=8 A_+(B).
Their projective heights are <=sqrt(2)B, and any physical preimage of a projective point of height<=H has R<=5H. Do not replace this realized image by all P^2(Q) of bounded height or all rational roots of H_r.


The fixed8 fiber is a structural receiver, not a fixed-power saving and not an independent density. The required moving support estimate remains open. Existing primary receiver P(B)<=B^o(1) A_1,1(B), its fixed-power budget, and the old hard one-twelfth branch budget are unchanged. A sufficient bound on the applicable hard-branch realized support would be B^(1/12-delta), with fixed delta>0, on the original physical measure; none is proved here.

Positive physical endpoints enumerated=0.

The audit rederived gcd and Cauchy bounds, ruled out identically zero scale fibers by constant1, checked134 uniqueness scope, separated canonical signed witnesses from arbitrary sign branches, and checked prior Fricke novelty. This is within-session auditing, not an independent external audit. Finite verification supports algebra replay; proofs above establish the uniform assertions.

# M3-T11-139 — Exact integer degree-eight cover and squared-diagonal Heron divisor receiver

## Current authority and scope
MAIN/INDEX/RESULT-LEDGER/active ROUTE current138, standalone138, targeted134 signed inverse and fresh denominator router are the current sources. Targeted Heron/projective text lookup in ROUTE found no earlier integer Heron receiver; bare signed-circle equations and eliminant remain133/134/138, not new underlying identities. No full-history reread. Keep exact primitive physical R, canonical ordered/sign-witnessed endpoints and every original content/coefficient/parity/orientation/cyclic mask. Fresh assertions retain134/137 odd split finite nonzero-u original-packet scope.120 physical adapter stays retracted.


## 1. Monic integer cover in Z=R^2
Use138's primitive integer plus vector A_i=e_i+f_i. Introduce integer minus vector B_i=e_i-f_i (NOT the historical anti-root denominators B_i; in this card call these Bminus_i).
Set Z=R^2 and
 Q_i=A_i^2(2Z-A_i^2),
 D_A(Z)=Z^4+sum Q_i^2-2Z^2 sum Q_i-2sum_(i<j)Q_i Q_j,
 P_A(Z)=D_A(Z)^2-64Z^2 Q_1 Q_2 Q_3.
Then P_A is an integer MONIC polynomial of degree8 in Z for every fixed nonzero integer A. This is the homogeneous form of138's scale polynomial: with r=(A_1/A_3,A_2/A_3,1), K=A_3^2/Z, H_r(K)=P_A(Z)/Z^8. Its leading monic coefficient cannot specialize away even if the degree in K drops.


Define four integer quadratic forms
 F_0=A_1^2+A_2^2+A_3^2,
 F_i=F_0-2A_i^2 (i=1,2,3),
 C_A=sum A_i^8-2sum_(i<j)A_i^4 A_j^4=-F_0 F_1 F_2 F_3.
Then D_A(0)=C_A and P_A(0)=C_A^2.


## 2. Stronger integer divisor necessity from the physical signed lift
Actual minus coordinates satisfy
 A_i^2+Bminus_i^2=2Z, sum A_i Bminus_i=-Z.
Consequently Q_i=(A_i Bminus_i)^2. The signed-sphere eliminant before squaring gives the exact sign
 D_A(Z)=-8Z product_i(A_i Bminus_i).
Indeed delta_i=A_i Bminus_i/Z has sum delta_i=-1; the radical-free bracket equals -8product delta_i, obtained by squaring that signed-sum relation twice. Thus Z divides D_A(Z). Since D_A(Z)=C_A modulo Z,
 R^2 divides C_A=-F_0 F_1 F_2 F_3.
Merely applying the rational-root theorem to P_A would only give R^2|C_A^2; the signed lift is needed for the stronger R^2|C_A.


When C_A is nonzero, every physical R is among the positive integers whose square divides |C_A|, followed by the exact P_A and physical lift tests. Since |C_A|<=24H_+^8, the divisor list is H_+^o(1);138 already gives the sharper at-most8 physical fibers. This does not count moving A and gives no new power saving.


Do not discard C_A=0. F_0>0, so this is one of the three quadratic carriers F_i=0. Then the square-divisor list is not finite and cannot serve as a generic enumeration step. P_A is still monic degree8, so138's physical fiber bound survives. Example A=(3,4,5) has C_A=0 but P_A(1)!=0: a vanishing factor alone is not a lift.


## 3. Exact signed integer reconstruction, retaining all masks
For a primitive odd nonzero A and a positive integer R, a physical signed lift is exactly a choice of integers Bminus_i such that
 Bminus_i^2=2R^2-A_i^2, sum A_i Bminus_i=-R^2,
 e_i=(A_i+Bminus_i)/2>0, f_i=(A_i-Bminus_i)/2.
A candidate also requires all original Stage37 packet and canonical-witness masks.


Proof of the elementary cuboid direction assertion: the square equations imply e_i^2+f_i^2=R^2; the signed sum gives sum e_i^2=R^2. Odd A forces R odd whenever these integer square equations hold (if R even, the right side for Bminus_i^2 is7 mod8), and Bminus_i odd, so e_i,f_i are integers. Positivity then supplies the three opposite-face diagonals. The endpoint is primitive automatically: a prime dividing every e_i divides R by the sphere equation, then every f_i by its circle equation, hence every A_i, contradicting gcd(A)=1.
Conversely an actual primitive endpoint with its chosen signed f gives these identities. The overall projective sign must be chosen to match positive edges; independently flipping A coordinates changes the projective point.


P_A(R^2)=0 and R^2|C_A are necessary, not sufficient. Check integer minus squares, actual signed sum, positive edges, and original packet masks explicitly. On134's open mask at most one positive ordered direction comes from each Z, hence at most8 endpoints per plus point, as138. Boundary samples below are not counted as endpoints.


## 4. Fresh square allocation into three quadratic forms — exact but dependent
Let p^lambda||m_i be an original odd split fresh relative prime, with v_p(R)=lambda and p outside all frozen contents. Write actual normalized anti-roots v_i and S as134/137. Directly from A_j^2=R^2(1+d_j),
 F_0/R^2=3+S, F_j/R^2=1+v_j.
At the target, v_i is a unit and v_i=u modp^(2lambda), with u^2=-1 modp^(2lambda). Since p is odd, 1+u is a unit (u=-1 modp would force2=0). Therefore
 v_p(F_i)=2lambda,
 v_p(F_0)=v_p(F_j)=0 for j!=i,
using v_p(S)=v_p(v_j)=-2lambda at the other two roots.
Hence if M_rel=m_1 m_2 m_3,
 m_i^2|F_i, zeta_i=F_i/m_i^2 is an integer, gcd(zeta_i,M_rel)=1,
 gcd(F_0,M_rel)=1.
If M_rel>1, all four F factors are nonzero: at any fresh prime all factors have the just-proved finite valuations. Thus C_A=0 forces M_rel=1 in this original fresh scope. Relative-fresh-empty packets must remain a separate branch.


For R<=B, |F_i|<=4R^2 and F_0<=6R^2, giving
 0<|zeta_i|<=4(B/m_i)^2 when M_rel>1.
Combining the global squared-diagonal divisor with this disjoint fresh allocation yields
 (R/M_rel)^2 | F_0 zeta_1 zeta_2 zeta_3.
Here R/M_rel is an integer but must not be replaced by a frozen packet constant; content and all-same/core support are retained.


NOVELTY FIREWALL: the fresh form allocation is a dependent integral pullback of the old actual unit/pole root-line, not a new character or probability restriction. From F_i/R^2=1+v_i its exact meaning is visible. Pairwise-coprime fresh factors do not authorize independent densities or multiplication of consumed savings. The new usable representation is the global monic integer equation, stronger signed-lift divisor, and exact candidate/lift interface on the physical height scale.

# M3-T11-140 — Physical Heron zero and full-factor saturation are empty; four-factor noncontent router


STATUS=PROVED_PHYSICAL_HERON_NONZERO_AND_NO_SINGLE_FACTOR_FULL_R_SQUARE
